concepts.def: A curated collection of poems on linked themes
A poem given without prior study in the exam
The voice that delivers the poem
The poem's overall shape — sonnet, ballad, free verse
The order and movement of ideas

walkthroughs.body_html:
The cluster: Ozymandias, London, The Prelude, My Last Duchess, Charge of the Light Brigade, Exposure, Storm on the Island, Bayonet Charge, Remains, Poppies, War Photographer, Tissue, The Émigrée, Checking Out Me History, Kamikaze.

Be able to name all 15, the poet and one defining feature.

Power of humans: Ozymandias, London, My Last Duchess, Tissue.

Power of nature: The Prelude, Storm on the Island, Exposure.

Conflict: Charge of the Light Brigade, Bayonet Charge, Remains, Poppies, War Photographer, Kamikaze, Émigrée, Checking Out Me History.

You'll see one named poem printed on the paper.

You pick a second poem from memory to compare. You have ~45 minutes. Focus on ideas, language, form and structure — and weave in light context.

mcqs.q: Which poem is NOT in the AQA Power and Conflict cluster?
How is the exam comparison structured?
options: One printed poem, one from memory
